description: Generate a short-lived presigned URL bearer capability for one B2 object — GetObject (download) or PutObject (upload). Prefer this for single-object transfers; use s3_create_multipart_upload and s3_get_presigned_upload_part_url for multipart uploads. The response includes the URL, operation, expiresIn, and expiresAt; treat the URL as sensitive until it expires. This is the preferred path for moving real object data: bytes flow directly between the client/worker and B2 and never pass through the MCP server. Note: presigned POST (browser form uploads) is NOT supported by B2; use a PutObject URL instead.

confirm.description: Fallback confirmation for minting a PutObject presigned URL bearer capability when the effective server destructive policy is 'confirm' and MCP elicitation cannot run.

contentType.description: For PutObject: restrict the upload to this content type.

expiresIn.description: URL expiry in seconds (default: 3600 = 1 hour, max: 604800 = 7 days).

operation.description: The operation the URL allows: GetObject to download or PutObject to upload.

versionId.description: For GetObject: the specific version ID to target.

name: s3_get_presigned_url
